newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila awards water contracts to Ayala, Benpres.
newsitem.headline: Manila awards water contracts to Ayala, Benpres.

text.p: The Philippines awarded contracts for Manila's water distribution to two groups led by Ayala Corp and Benpres Holdings Corp, state-agency Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS) said on Saturday.
MWSS said in a statement that Public Works Secretary Gregorio Vigilar had signed the contracts with representatives of the Ayala and Benpres consortia.

The government awarded the contracts to the winners of the January 23 MWSS bidding after the Court of Appeals lifted on Wednesday an order restraining President Fidel Ramos from proceeding with the privatisation of Manila's waterworks and sewerage system.
The government had offered two 25-year concessions to run the city's waterworks sytem.
The consortium of Ayala, Bechtel Corp of the United States and United Utilities Plc of Britain won the east zone concession. The west zone was won by Benpres with France's Lyonnaise des Eaux SA
Vigilar said the contracts entail $7.5 billion in investments for modernisation and expansion of the water supply and sewerage system. -- Manila (632) 841-89-36, fax 817-62-67
